import "strings"
from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: -3m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "W" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id =~ /circuit_breaker_(${breaker:pipe})_power/)
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, breaker: strings.toTitle(v: strings.replaceAll(v: strings.trimSuffix(v: strings.trimPrefix(v: r.entity_id, prefix: "circuit_breaker_"), suffix: "_power"), t: "_", u: " "))}))
  |> group(columns: ["breaker"])

import "strings"
